name: doaj
description: DOAJ (Directory of Open Access Journals): search and look up open-access journals and articles through DOAJ's public v4 API, OAI-PMH endpoint and Atom feed.

commands.name: search-journals

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword(s) or Lucene query string. Field filters use JSON dot notation, e.g. bibjson.publisher.country:IR, bibjson.apc.has_apc:false, bibjson.title:"Journal of Science". Combine them with AND/OR. Shor

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as field or field:asc|desc, using dot notation, e.g. created_date:desc, last_updated:desc, bibjson.title:asc

commands.name: get-journal-by-issn
commands.summary: Look up a DOAJ journal by its print or electronic ISSN

commands.name: get-journal
commands.summary: Get the full metadata of a DOAJ journal (APC, license, editorial policy, subjects, links) by its DOAJ id

params.name: id
params.description: DOAJ journal id (32-char hex), taken from search results

commands.name: search-articles
commands.summary: Search DOAJ articles by keyword or Lucene query, e.g. bibjson.year:2021 AND herring

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword(s) or Lucene query string. Field filters use dot notation, e.g. bibjson.year:2021, bibjson.journal.title:"Ecology and Evolution". Short fields: title, doi, issn, publisher, abstract. Combine t

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as field or field:asc|desc, e.g. created_date:desc or last_updated:desc. Sorting by bibjson.year returns bad_request.

commands.name: get-article-by-doi
commands.summary: Look up a DOAJ article by its DOI

params.name: doi
params.description: DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix, e.g. 10.1002/ece3.8411

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get the full metadata of a DOAJ article (authors, abstract, journal, links) by its DOAJ id

params.name: id
params.description: DOAJ article id (32-char hex), taken from search results

commands.summary: List journals recently added to DOAJ (Atom feed)

notes: The HTML pages (home, /toc, /article) are behind Cloudflare, and /search/* is disallowed by robots.txt. Use only the public API, OAI-PMH and the feed.

Search queries are Elasticsearch query_string (Lucene) syntax placed in the URL path. Use JSON dot-notation fields (bibjson.publisher.country:IR, bibjson.apc.has_apc:false, bibjson.year:2021) and combine them with AND/OR. Append .exact for exact match on full field names. Wildcards (*) are rejected.
Forward slashes in queries (e.g. DOIs) are escaped automatically by the API.
Search responses include total, page, pageSize and next/last URLs. The maximum pageSize is 100, and deep paging is limited, so narrow the query instead.
Sorting by bibjson.year on articles returns bad_request. created_date and last_updated work.

OAI-PMH ListRecords returns one batch plus a resumptionToken under OAI-PMH.ListRecords.resumptionToken. Fetching later batches needs /oai?verb=ListRecords&resumptionToken=..., which this CLI does not wrap.
Write endpoints (applications/articles CRUD) need a publisher api_key and are not included.
Full data dumps are available on request (see /docs/public-data-dump/), and a journal CSV export is documented at /docs/journal-csv.
